name: Gathering the Cure
summary: In Darkshore, sick deer need a salve, and Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine shows a young druid how to make one. The remedy calls for water and healing plants gathered nearby.

sections.title: A Remedy for Darkshore's Wildlife
sections.body: Alanndarian Nightsong seeks a cure for Darkshore's sick deer. A contaminated water source has harmed the local wildlife, so sampled Cliffspring water will form the salve's base. Natural ingredients with healing power must complete the mixture. The deer cannot recover alone, and the Cenarion Circle needs a remedy soon.

sections.title: Roots and Lunar Blooms
sections.body: Earthroot and Lunar Fungus lend healing power to the salve. Earthroot grows in rocky soil, where a practiced herbalist's eye helps find it. Lunar Fungus blooms in caves east of Auberdine. The moonkin there have grown territorial and agitated, making the gathering more dangerous.

sections.title: The Path to Poison Cleansing
sections.body: Alanndarian Nightsong teaches the initiate how much care it takes to brew a remedy for a specific toxin. Each step in gathering and preparing the ingredients demands care. The lesson prepares the druid to cleanse poisons with nature magic, without a separate brew for each one.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Gathering the Cure?
aliases: what is gathering the cure for
faq.answer: A druid initiate gathers Earthroot and Lunar Fungus for Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine. The ingredients make a curative salve for Darkshore's sick deer, while the work teaches how remedies can counter poisons.

faq.q: Where does the Lunar Fungus grow?
faq.answer: Lunar Fungus grows in caves in the hills directly east of Auberdine. Wild moonkin there have grown territorial and aggressive.

faq.q: Do I need to be an herbalist to get Earthroot?
faq.answer: You do not need Herbalism to obtain Earthroot, though it grows in wild herb patches. Without the skill, you need to trade with an herbalist or get the herb from someone else for Alanndarian's recipe.

Alanndarian Nightsong is a night elf in Auberdine who called on the Cenarion Circle for aid. She watches over Darkshore's plants and animals and guides young druids through their first trials to cleanse and protect the wilds.

faq.q: Why are the deer in Darkshore sick?
faq.answer: Darkshore's deer drank water tainted by a contaminated spring. The poison leaves them suffering, unable to recover without a curative salve.

faq.q: How does this quest help me learn Cure Poison?
faq.answer: The training teaches initiates the care needed to prepare herbal antidotes for individual poisons. The Cenarion Circle uses that lesson to prepare druids to channel nature magic that can neutralize poison.

angles.text: As a druid, you learn how ordinary remedies work against natural toxins. That knowledge prepares you to channel curative power without relying on tools.
As an herbalist, you have the trained eye Alanndarian values for finding Earthroot in the wild.
As a night elf, you share the kaldorei duty to protect Darkshore's sacred groves and wildlife, in reverence for Elune and the spirits of the wild.
